title: Bridge link down
symptom: bridge.online fails; station shows link down.
cause: The LabVIEW bridge has not published a retained status=online (controller not running, or broker unreachable).

remedy.text: Start the LabVIEW MQTT Bridge and confirm it publishes retained tmf/{station}/status {state:online}. Verify Mosquitto is up on :1883.

title: Instrument self-test failed
cause: The instrument's built-in self test failed — possible hardware fault, miscalibration, or fixture/wiring issue.

remedy.text: Re-seat the instrument and fixture, power-cycle, and re-run in maintenance mode. If it persists, calibrate or RMA per the instrument manual.
